description: This file defines a custom exception class 'PerformanceTrackerServiceException' within the 'OrangeHRM\Performance\Exception' namespace. The class extends the base PHP 'Exception' and includes a static method to generate a specific error message related to editing an employee with existing review logs.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling specific errors related to performance tracking services within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: cannotEditEmployeeWithLogs
methods.description: Returns an instance of the exception with a message indicating that an employee cannot be updated due to existing review logs.

methods.name: cannotEditEmployeeWithLogs
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'PerformanceTrackerServiceException' with a specific message about employee update restrictions.

calls: new self("The employee cannot be updated since the performance tracker already contains review logs")
